Nurse Found Dead in Telangana; BJP Alleges Murder, Police Arrest Suspect

A nurse was found dead in her home in Telangana's Rangareddy district. One outlet reported that the BJP alleged assault and murder in connection with the death. Another outlet reported that police have arrested a suspect in the alleged rape-murder of the 21-year-old nurse.
